share.title: Public link
share.hint: Expose this workbench on a public HTTPS URL via a tunnel provider. Fixed names need your own relay or a free account.
share.hint.cloudflared: Instant random URL — no account needed. The URL changes on every start.
share.hint.sish: Your own SSH relay (sish). The subdomain derives from your key — survives IP changes.
share.hint.ngrok: Free dev domain (xxx.ngrok-free.app). Authtoken from dashboard.ngrok.com.
share.hint.zrok: Free reserved name (name.share.zrok.io). Enable token from the zrok invite.
share.hint.bore: Persistent subdomain (name.bore.dk). Requires one free sign-in at bore.dk.
share.boreNeedSignIn: bore.dk asks for one free sign-in — the link opens on any device.
share.pubkeyHint: Authorize this key on your sish relay
